name: Muse Spark
summary: Muse Spark is Meta Superintelligence Labs' multimodal reasoning model family for agentic work, coding and computer use. It runs the Thinking mode in the Meta AI app and is offered to developers through the OpenAI-compatible Meta Model API; version 1.3 is the current release.
facts: $0.10 / $0.20 per 1M tokens; data used to improve Meta products
Muse Spark Open, 816B MoE (42B active), Oct 2026
goodFor: Teams that want a self-hostable sibling
watchOut: Cheapest tier trains on your data
Fast version churn (1.1 to 1.3 in two months)
Open variant uses a custom Muse license
